info.name: RAGBook
info.description:
API collection for the RAGBook RAG application.

**Health**: server smoke test, run this first.
**E2E Flow**: sequential happy path, use with the Collection Runner.
**Collections / Documents / Ingest / Search**: individual APIs, with auto-save of variables.
**Cleanup**: deletions, at the end so a full run reaches it with everything still standing.

The folder order is designed to support a Run of the whole collection.

variable.description: Auto-set by 'Health Check'. warming | ready | error.
Safety guard: 'Delete Test Collections' deletes ONLY collections whose name starts with this prefix. Empty it and the request deletes nothing.

manual = every request runs normally (default, manual use). full = meant for the Runner on the WHOLE collection: skips standalone folders and redundant cleanups, leaving Health + E2E Flow + prefix wipe.
Test server port (run_test_server.sh). Change to 8000 only if you really want to hit the dev server and its real data.
Auto-set by 'Create Collection'. UUID of the target collection.
Auto-set by the 'Collections' folder. Kept separate from collection_id so individual requests don't delete the E2E Flow's collection.
Auto-set by 'Ingest Document'. UUID of the ingested document.
Name for the collection created during the E2E flow.
Description for the collection created during the E2E flow.
Auto-set by 'Ingest Document'. Original filename of the ingested file.
